pack.assume.count: Mid qayb isku xidh ama faalfo oo ku jira naqshadda; isku xidhka (alxanka, soolder, solvent) lama tiriyo.

net.beyond: Qaar ka mid ah baahida ayaa ka baxsan dhammaadka khadka baahida. Ku qor khadka xeerkaaga si aad uga sii socoto.
net.defaults: Baahidu waxay isticmaalaysaa khad caadi ah oo calaamad leh, lumitaanka qaybaha isku xidha waa qiimo caadi ah oo la wareejiyey. Ka hubi injineerkaaga ka hor intaadan isku halleyn.
